the foundation stiffness of suction caissons is highly dependent on the initial installation procedure, and that a suction installation method is not suitable for offshore met mast or wind turbine applications where serviceability is of paramount concern.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
suction caisson foundations are capable of providing serviceability limits which meet the design requirements of offshore structures.

suction caisson foundations have the potential to provide a viable solution to the foundation design of offshore structures, provided that the serviceability performance is adequately considered in the design.

suction caissons can provide a cost-effective alternative foundation for offshore wind turbines and met masts.
suction caisson founded structures can have a serviceable performance, but only if the design is carefully considered.
